name: Pore Panic
summary:
Welcome to Pore Panic, a cozy VR skincare salon where every squeeze counts!

Slip on your virtual gloves, prepare your customer, and get hands-on with faces covered in pimples and blackheads. Use hand tracking to squeeze blemishes, try treatment tools, and enjoy satisfying pops. Find the right pressure, watch your customer’s reactions, and finish with soothing aftercare.
Build your dream salon—one satisfying squeeze at a time!
